## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. Distinguish simulated checks from
provider or hardware testing.

## Deployment impact

Describe configuration, schema, dependency, migration, or rollback changes.
Write "None" if there is no deployment impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; no routine test sends live hardware commands.
- [ ] Fixtures, logs, and examples contain no credentials or private installation data.
- [ ] Notable user-facing changes are recorded in the changelog.
